title: SREV-140 HostInject service restart state

executor.description: HostInjectProcessUtil enumerates active services and restarts only policy/injection mismatches

service_state_gate.description: RestartService waits for SERVICE_STOPPED before StartServiceW

buffer_owner.description: EnumServicesStatusExW byte buffer allocated with new[] is released with delete[]

runtime_matrix.description: Windows SCM restart proof for stopped, stop-pending, failed-stop, and HostInjectProcess mismatch services

contracts: HostInjectProcessUtil.cpp owns only the executor edge enumerate active services compare policy to module-injection state then restart mismatches
BuildSvcSet and IsSvcInjected policy matching remain unchanged
A restart stop edge is complete only when QueryServiceStatusEx reports SERVICE_STOPPED or the service was already inactive
StartServiceW may run only after the stop edge is complete
If stop fails for a reason other than already-inactive or stop-pending state the executor must not issue a blind start against the still-running service
Stop-pending state may be waited through QueryServiceStatusEx
The service enumeration buffer allocated with new BYTE[] must be released with delete[]
